mutations.name: B1 the per-source deadline is dropped: every source is read to completion, so the request is unbounded again and the caller waits for the slowest read however long that takes - the 34-second success half of the measured defect

mutations.name: B2 the page stops saying it is short, so a partial read is indistinguishable from a complete one and the dashboard draws a space that looks emptier than it is
mutations.expectRed: 2.3 the answer says it is PARTIAL rather than looking complete

mutations.name: B3 the missing sources stop being NAMED, leaving a count that tells a reader something is gone and not what, which on this dashboard is the difference between one slow channel and an empty space
mutations.expectRed: 2.6 the names are the sources, not a count dressed as one

mutations.expectRed: 4.0 one failing channel does not make the whole aggregation throw
